# Professional Headshots

Professional headshots: a studio headshot of yourself from your own photo in your MegaScenes library, with the same face and the outfit and background you pick, for profiles and resumes.

## What it does
Pick a photo of yourself from your MegaScenes library and choose the outfit, background and style. Claude tells you the price and makes a headshot that keeps your face.

**How the files are made:** each headshot is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Only from your own photo or one of someone who agreed to it, never of a famous person.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install professional-headshots@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Professional Headshots talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/headshot/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each headshot uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The headshots show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_headshot_models` | Models for headshots with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_headshot_cost` | Exact price of one headshot before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_headshot` | Starts one headshot in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_headshot` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Make a professional headshot from my latest MegaScenes photo"
- "Turn my portrait photo into a LinkedIn headshot in a navy suit"
- "Create a creative headshot of me on a gray studio background"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the headshot (the photo you pick from your library and the outfit, background and style) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
